evidence.title: GitHub - punkpeye/awesome-mcp-servers: A collection of MCP servers.

name: awesome-mcp-servers
summary: Curated list of Model Context Protocol servers, grouped by topic and tagged by language, scope and OS.
description: A curated awesome list of MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers you install and run yourself. Entries are grouped into 50+ topic categories — aggregators, browser automation, cloud platforms, databases, finance, search, travel and more — and tagged with programming language, local vs cloud scope and supported OS; each links to its repository. The list also collects MCP clients, hosted remote servers, tutorials, frameworks and a web directory synced with the repository.
contains: 50+ server categories from aggregators and databases to finance and travel
legend tags: language (Python, TypeScript, Go, Rust, C#), scope cloud/local/embedded, OS macOS/Windows/Linux
companion lists for MCP clients and hosted remote MCP servers
web directory synced with the repository
